name: The Supreme Lord of Darkness: Celisa
source:
Celisa likes fire. Perhaps a little too much, considering it killed her and she's now in the Underworld working for it's ruler.

She has been delegated three tasks, and she can finish them all by lunch! ... If she can avoid the various possible ways to die again while completing them.

[From [url=https://nell-and-void.itch.io/the-supreme-lord-of-darkness-celisa]Itch.io[/url]]
